_doc: Demo46 thermal plan (firmware DUAL; DEMO_DESIGN_GUIDE §3) — format as Demo44/45 (tools/thermal/plan_sim.py). az: 0 front, -90 LEFT ear, +90 RIGHT ear. Special setting (told in g07, visible: the wing's inner membrane glows faint orange): a dragon's wing holds fire inside, so his closed wing is WARM at your left ear. Magic smoke (Hinata's entrance) and the glowing book = no temperature.

@study.why: the study at night: fireplace on the RIGHT, frosted tall window on the LEFT

@smoke.why: Hinata appears in a puff of black smoke: no temperature

@tea.why: the cup of hot black tea held up in front of your face (steam)

@tea_off.why: you've drunk; the cup goes down

@valley.why: the cliff edge of the dragon valley at dusk: hard wind from the LEFT (north peaks)

@takeoff_gust.why: he spreads his wings and leaps: the downdraft of the wings hits you = the COLD PEAK, both ears (on top of the cliff wind: left ≈ .95, right ≈ .45 + spill)

@breath.why: his dragon breath lights the stone beacon AHEAD of you (real fire, a few metres away) = the WARM PEAK, then the beacon burns on

@wing.why: silent: his wing closes around you from the LEFT — the wind is cut and the wing's inner fire warms your left ear (told in g07): left ear cold → warm in < 1 s

@lake.why: the frozen lake: cold ice under you and the still night air, both ears

@song_far.why: his song begins far away across the ice on the RIGHT (his voice: barely warm at this distance)

@song_near.why: he has walked up to you, on your right

@cloak.why: half his cloak around you: the ice-cold air is cut, the cloth warms both sides a little

@night.why: the study late at night: the fire burned low on the RIGHT, the frosted window on the LEFT

@sunrise.why: dawn: the sun through the frosted window (left, front-left), embers on the right, cold morning air

showcase.fast_switch: valley: @wing (left ear: cliff wind .5 cool → wing .45 warm, silent, < 1 s) — the special setting is told in g07 and visible (orange glow inside the wing)
showcase.peak: valley: @takeoff_gust .9 cool both ears; @breath .82 warm ahead
showcase.direction: valley: wind from the LEFT; study: window LEFT cool / fire RIGHT warm; lake: his song walks in from the far right
showcase.same_ear_dual: study: h06 at the right ear by the fire vs the window cool on the left; night: window cool + voice; dawn: sun + morning chill
